name: Ribociclib
mechanism: Selective CDK4/6 inhibitor inducing G1 arrest via RB hypophosphorylation; used with endocrine therapy in advanced and selected early breast cancer.
monitoring: ECG at baseline and early in treatment, and electrolytes
Liver function tests regularly during the early months
interactions: Avoid QT-prolonging drugs and tamoxifen co-administration (increased QT risk). Ribociclib is a CYP3A4 inhibitor; avoid strong CYP3A inducers/inhibitors.
resistance: As for other CDK4/6 inhibitors: RB1 loss, cyclin E-CDK2 activation, PI3K pathway activation and ESR1 mutations.
